title: Welfare Losses from Aggregate Socioeconomic and Environmental Shocks in Asia and the Pacific
citable_blocker: SOURCE-QUEUE.md — 3 wrong URLs, 26 unreachable sources, coverage gaps
headline: What the Region's Shocks Actually Cost, and Which Losses Last
standfirst: COVID-19, price and debt crises, and climate disasters each damaged welfare differently. Comparing them honestly means refusing to add deaths, lost schooling, and lost output into a single number.
hero_caption: Comparative magnitude of selected welfare losses, shown in four panels because the units are not commensurate.
